summary: Prism Chambers is the radiant apex of Crystal Root, where Brell’s divine resonance refracts into infinite colors. Prismatic guardians defend the chamber, and the Prism Sovereign rules over the spectrum of divine energy.
history: Prism Chambers formed when resonance energy reached critical density.
Crystal walls refracted Brell’s divine power into prismatic forms.
Prismatic guardians emerged from the first refraction waves.
The Prism Sovereign arose as the living embodiment of radiant resonance.
